en-US.description: Share screenshots via Internet in seconds: take a shot, edit it quickly and send to the Internet, to get a link which you can immediately provide to anyone
en-US.longDescription: Jet Screenshot is a service enabling you to share screenshot via the internet in seconds. It allows you to take a screen snap, edit it and send it to the Web, so that you can immediately provide anyone with a link to the image. Such an approach allows you to speed up sharing of ideas, facilitating further discussion. It's ideal for remote work of programmers, designers, QA testers, bloggers, technical assistance specialists, sales managers, etc...
en-US.name: Jet Screenshot

zh-CN.description: 在几秒钟内通过互联网分享屏幕截图：拍摄、快速编辑并发送到互联网，获得一个链接，可立即提供给任何人
zh-CN.longDescription: Jet Screenshot 是一项能让您在几秒钟内通过互联网共享屏幕截图的服务。它允许您截取屏幕快照、编辑并发送到网络，这样您就可以立即向任何人提供图像链接，从而更快分享想法，促进进一步讨论。它是程序员、设计师、质量保证测试人员、博客作者、技术援助专家、销售经理等远程工作的理想选择。
